reconfigure.description: Change the region or log in again for {username}.

error.no_devices: No supported Owlet sock found on this account
error.rate_limited: Owlet is rate limiting logins at the moment, wait a few minutes and try again

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between requests to the Owlet cloud, minimum 5. Every poll costs several API calls per sock, a lower value increases the risk of rate limiting.
data_description.stale_threshold: When the Owlet cloud has no new reading for this many minutes, vitals become unavailable and the Data stale sensor turns on. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.activation_interval: Longest time between two APP_ACTIVE writes, the signal that tells the base station a client is watching so it keeps uploading vitals. The base station uploads for about 45 seconds after each write and then reports that it stopped; the integration writes again as soon as it sees that, so this is only a ceiling. Between 10 and 600.
data_description.allow_control: Lets Home Assistant switch the base station on and off, which turns the Base station on sensor into a switch. Off by default: the integration then only writes APP_ACTIVE and can never stop the monitoring, not by an automation, a dashboard tap or a voice assistant.

stale_data.title: Owlet data has not been updated for a long time
stale_data.description:
{name} has not sent a new reading to the Owlet cloud since {last_reading}, while the sock is not charging and the base station is on.

Check that the base station has power and Wi-Fi, and that the Owlet app shows live data. This message disappears by itself once new readings arrive.

command_failed.message: Sending the command to the Owlet cloud failed
